name: Ball-playing centre-back
description: More carries, passes, receptions; less own-box share, long-pass share than others in the group.
examples: ['Jeison Murillo', 'Lorenzo Tonelli', 'João Miranda de Souza Filho', 'Federico Fernández', 'Maxime Le Marchand']

name: Box-defending stopper
description: More own-box share, long-pass share, opponent-box share; less passes, carries than others in the group.

name: Wide centre-back (back three)
description: More distance from centre, average action depth, crosses (open play); less own-box share, clearances (adj.) than others in the group.

name: Touchline progressor
description: More distance from centre, progressive passes, forward-pass share; less opponent-box share, lateral spread than others in the group.

name: Overlapping attacking full-back
description: More average action depth, final-third share, opponent-box share; less clearances (adj.), own-box share than others in the group.

name: Possession full-back
description: More carries, receptions, passes; less own-box share, forward-pass share than others in the group.

name: Conservative full-back
description: More own-box share, forward-pass share, long-pass share; less carries, receptions than others in the group.
examples: ['Joel Ward', 'Dorian Lévêque', 'Alberto Lora', 'Pablo Jean Antoine Martínez', 'Mouhamadou Dabo']

name: Aggressive defending full-back
description: More pressures (adj.), tackles (adj.), aerial duels; less crosses (open play), passes leading to shots than others in the group.
examples: ["Danilo D'Ambrosio", 'Mathieu Deplagne', 'Hugo Mallo', 'Elderson Uwa Echiejile', 'Alex Ferrari']

name: Deep controller
description: More carries, passes, ball recoveries (adj.); less opponent-box share, distance from centre than others in the group.

name: Long-passing creator
description: More passes leading to shots, crosses (open play), long-pass share; less tackles (adj.), blocks (adj.) than others in the group.

name: Holding screen
description: More own-box share, clearances (adj.), forward-pass share; less average action depth, defensive action height than others in the group.
examples: ['Mato Jajalo', "Gary O'Neil", 'Nicola Rigoni', 'Jérôme Le Moigne', 'Tomás Pina']

name: Progressive box-to-box
description: More receptions, progressive carries, defensive action height; less own-box share, clearances (adj.) than others in the group.

name: Box-crashing midfielder
description: More opponent-box share, final-third share, average action depth; less passes, carries than others in the group.

name: Central creative playmaker
description: More passes, carries, receptions; less opponent-box share, distance from centre than others in the group.

name: Hard-working wide midfielder
description: More own-box share, clearances (adj.), forward-pass share; less average action depth, defensive action height than others in the group.

name: Inside forward / goal threat
description: More opponent-box share, final-third share, chance quality per shot; less progressive passes, passes than others in the group.

name: Dribbling winger
description: More progressive carries, take-ons attempted, crosses (open play); less own-box share, clearances (adj.) than others in the group.

name: Dribbling channel-runner
description: More carries, progressive carries, take-ons attempted; less opponent-box share, aerial duels than others in the group.

name: Wide-roaming worker
description: More lateral spread, tackles (adj.), distance from centre; less average action depth, defensive action height than others in the group.

name: Penalty-box target striker
description: More opponent-box share, aerial duels, own-box share; less distance from centre, lateral spread than others in the group.

name: Mobile front-line finisher
description: More final-third share, average action depth, defensive action height; less aerial duels, fouls committed than others in the group.
examples: ['Daniel Sturridge', 'Karim Benzema', 'Martin Braithwaite', 'Romelu Lukaku', 'Wissam Ben Yedder']
